title: Count who opened the last licence before you buy another
sub: Every vendor already gives an admin the answer. Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude each report last active date and active days per seat.

items.title: One row per seat
items.body: Name, tool, last active date, active days in the last 28.
items.action: Pull the usage report from each admin console. Do not ask people; read the report.

items.title: Three bands, decided before you look at the names
items.body: Never (0 days), Tried (1 to 3), Uses (4 or more). Set them first or you will move them.
items.action: Write the thresholds at the top of the sheet before you sort.

items.title: One number for the board
items.body: Seats used over seats paid, as a fraction, every month. Not a percentage buried in a slide.
items.action: Put it in the same place on the same page each month.

items.title: Ask the Uses band one question
items.body: What do you use it for most? Three of the answers will be the same task.
items.action: Write that task down. It is your team library, already proven on your own work.

items.title: Talk to the bottom three before any vendor
items.body: Ask what they tried, what happened and why they stopped. A second product will not fix a first one nobody was shown.
items.action: Only then decide whether the problem is the tool.
